blocks.h2: Water Treatment Options for Mokena Homes

tiles.body: Better-tasting drinking and cooking water at the kitchen sink.
Filtered water at every tap and shower.
Less scale on fixtures, glass doors and in the water heater.
Filters and softeners matched to what's in your well.

bodies: Testing comes first. We check the things that affect your plumbing and your taste buds, like hardness, iron, chlorine and sediment, and explain the results in plain terms.

If you're on a private well, testing tells us what treatment you actually need. For health-related questions about well water, the Will County Health Department and state-certified labs offer well water testing, and we're happy to point you to them.

blocks.intro: Most Mokena homes get Lake Michigan water from the City of Chicago. Some homes in and around town are on private wells.

items.body: Lake Michigan water is treated before it reaches you. Many homeowners still filter it for taste or to protect appliances.
Well water can carry iron, sediment and hardness that stain fixtures and build up in the water heater.
A softener or filter can help a new heater or [tankless unit](/mokena/tankless-water-heater) last longer.

blocks.h2: Water Filtration Questions From Mokena Homeowners

items.q: Does Mokena village water need a filter?
items.preview: It's treated, but many people filter for taste.
items.answer: Village water is treated and tested. Most people who add a filter do it for taste, smell or to protect fixtures and appliances.

items.q: I'm on a private well. What should I test for?
items.preview: Start with hardness, iron and sediment.
items.answer: For plumbing, start with hardness, iron and sediment. For health questions, get a full test from a state-certified lab.

items.q: Do I need a water softener?
items.answer: It depends on your water. We test the hardness and tell you whether a softener is worth it for your home.

items.q: How often do filters need changing?
items.answer: Under-sink cartridges usually last several months. Whole-house filters vary. We'll tell you the schedule for yours.

items.q: How much does water filtration cost in Mokena?
items.preview: It depends on the system. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what your water needs and the system you choose. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we install.
